subject: Upcoming Travel Itinerary
body: Dear [Recipient], I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to share the details of our upcoming travel itinerary for the business conference next month. We have booked flights on [Airline] departing on [Date] and returning on [Date]. The hotel reservation has been confirmed at [Hotel Name] for [Number] nights. Please let me know if you have any preferences or need any further information. Looking forward to traveling together! Best regards, [Your Name]
